suite: Reproducao de listener defeituoso durante gasto de recursos do jogador

result.exception: InvalidOperationException: Falha controlada do listener de recursos do jogador.

finding: The resource mutation occurs before the direct multicast event invocation. The throwing callback escapes after debit, prevents later callbacks, and stops TrySpendPlayer before RecordTransaction runs.
next: Isolate OnRecursosAtualizados subscribers in GerenciadorRecursos.NotificarAtualizacao; test spend, add/refund and adjacent purchase/rollback paths before further changes.
